_comment: Per-group season format for basketball 2026/27 — the input to 'how many home games does this team need?'.
SOURCE: 'Übersicht Teamanmeldungen_26-27_29.07.2026.xlsx', sheet 'Prov. Gruppeneinteilung',
columns Modus + Anzahl Spiele on each group's header row. Read 2026-08-06.
⚠⚠ home games = gamesTotal / 2, NOT (group size − 1). The workbook states the games per team
outright and it does NOT equal a double round-robin:
D1LRA   8 teams  → 18 Spiele  (a double round would be 14)   → 9 home, not 7
D2LRA  10 teams  → 16 Spiele  (a double round would be 18)   → 8 home, not 9
DU14 Regional 11 teams → 6 Spiele                            → 3 home, not 10
The first version of this file derived the count from group size and was WRONG for every
team whose group is not a plain full double round — including Lions D1, one of the two
teams that file with ProBasket by 17.08.2026. Never reintroduce the arithmetic.
⚠ gamesTotal is INDEPENDENT of whether the final group is fixed. DU14 Regional still lists
the whole 11-team league (the split happens at the Spielplansitzung) yet its game count is
already stated. So a count can be known while the opponents are not.
STATUS — why a count is absent, when it is:
provisional = the workbook states no Anzahl Spiele yet (H4LRA, HU14/HU16 Regional).
tournament  = Turniere / Miniturniere; not played home-and-away, so the question does
not apply (Girs got Games, Miniturniere).
championship = a stated Anzahl Spiele; gamesTotal carries it.
⚠ An ODD gamesTotal (e.g. DU18 Inter, 7 Spiele Einfachrunde) cannot split evenly — the
helper reports floor() and flags it approximate. No KSCW group is odd today.
⚠ KNOWN DISCREPANCY, flagged not resolved: this workbook puts 'KSC Wiedikon MU8' in the
DU10 group (Girs got Games), while basketballGroups.ts keys 6724 to MixU8. Both are
tournament formats so neither yields a count and nothing numeric depends on it — but the
opponent lists differ. Reconcile at the next re-extract.
Keys are the BB_GROUPS keys in basketballGroups.ts, verbatim.
